meta.title: OSIDAC — Virtual stores, daily missions, and community
meta.description: Manage a virtual store, complete daily missions, and collect KOIN points for in-app use. Cash top-ups and withdrawals are not available.

hero.badge: Virtual store · daily missions · steady progress
hero.title: Open your digital storefront. Move forward every day.
hero.subtitle: Manage a virtual store, complete daily missions, and collect KOIN points for in-app use. KOIN points are not cash and cannot be withdrawn.
hero.imageAlt: Small business owner checking her phone in a warm cafe

how.title: A simple way to get started
how.subtitle: Create a free account, open a virtual store, and explore the activities currently available.
how.buyHook: Sign up and open your store
how.buyText: Registration is free. You do not need to buy a membership to use the available virtual store and daily missions.
how.buyAlt: A virtual storefront on a phone with an in-app rewards balance
how.getText: Collect KOIN points through in-app activities. They are app points only; they have no cash value and cannot be redeemed.
how.getAlt: A person checking a daily task list on a phone
how.wdHook: Track your activity in one wallet
how.wdText: View your KOIN point balance and activity history. Cash top-ups and withdrawals are not available.
how.wdAlt: Small business owner checking a phone in her shop

earn.title: Explore what is available today
earn.subtitle: Start with a virtual store, daily missions, and referral tracking. Paid partner offers, game rewards, network commissions, and cash withdrawals are not available.
earn.storeText: Claim KOIN points from the virtual store every eight hours. KOIN points are for in-app use only and have no cash value.
earn.missionText: Complete check-ins and verified referral activities. Paid partner missions are not available.
earn.playText: Game-based rewards are not available. Partner activities will appear after an integration is enabled.
earn.teamText: Share an invite link and track your network. Network commissions are not available.

packages.title: Planned virtual-store tiers
packages.subtitle: No paid package is for sale today. These are planned digital virtual-store tiers inside the app—not machines or hardware. Prices are for reference only, and checkout is disabled.

starter.name: Starter Booth
starter.desc: Planned store start at level 2, with a future 1.2× multiplier for eligible partner-mission OSID rewards. Neither benefit is active yet.

kios.name: Kios Pro
kios.desc: Planned store start at level 4, with a future 1.4× multiplier for eligible partner-mission OSID rewards. Neither benefit is active yet.

gold.name: Warung Gold
gold.desc: Planned store start at level 6, with a future 1.6× multiplier for eligible partner-mission OSID rewards. Neither benefit is active yet.

elite.name: Franchise Elite
elite.desc: Planned store start at level 8, with a future 1.8× multiplier for eligible partner-mission OSID rewards. Neither benefit is active yet.

master.name: Empire Master
master.desc: Planned store start at level 10, with a future 2.0× multiplier for eligible partner-mission OSID rewards. Neither benefit is active yet.

packages.accessNote: No tier unlocks extra missions today. Mission access rules and partner inventory must be approved and connected first.

network.title: Grow with the OSIDAC community
network.subtitle: Invite people to join and follow your direct and extended network. Network commissions are not available.
network.note: Referral tracking helps you build community; no network commissions are currently paid. Available features do not require a tier purchase.
network.imageAlt: Two small business owners talking while reviewing a tablet

transparency.title: Know what your balance represents
transparency.subtitle: KOIN points are internal app points, not money. Cash top-ups and withdrawals are not available. Full terms will be shown before any financial feature is enabled.
transparency.formula: KOIN points have no cash value and cannot be withdrawn.
transparency.disclaimer: OSIDAC is not an investment product and does not promise income. No crypto assets are used.

cta.title: Start with your own virtual store.
cta.subtitle: Create a free account to explore available store and mission features. KOIN points are not redeemable for cash.

footer.legal: OSIDAC is not an investment product and does not promise income. KOIN points are in-app points with no cash value. Paid tiers, partner missions, network commissions, cash top-ups, and withdrawals are not available yet.

auth.registerSubtitle: Create a free account. No membership purchase is required.
auth.confirmNotice: Check your email to confirm your account.

pwa.title: Take OSIDAC with you
pwa.subtitle: Install the app for a faster, full-screen experience.
pwa.iosHint: In Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.

store.title: My virtual store
store.claimed: Claim complete. KOIN points were added to your in-app ledger.
store.insufficient: Not enough KOIN points to upgrade this virtual store.
store.maxLevel: You have reached the highest store level.
store.coinNote: KOIN is a non-cash in-app points ledger—not OSID or IDR. KOIN cannot be withdrawn, and no approved KOIN-to-OSID conversion rule is available yet.

missions.title: Missions
missions.subtitle: Complete daily in-app tasks. Paid partner offers and surveys are not available.
missions.soon: Paid partner missions are not available.
missions.dailySubtitle: Check in and complete in-app actions to collect KOIN points. These are not cash rewards.
missions.rewardNote: Check-in and referral rewards go to the in-app KOIN ledger. KOIN is not OSID or IDR and does not convert automatically. OSID rewards depend on verified, funded partner campaigns and settlement.
missions.inviteDescription: A friend signs up with your invite link today.
missions.shareDescription: Share an invite. The referral mission becomes available after a friend signs up.
missions.shareSuccess: Invite link is ready to share.
missions.storeDescription: A regular in-app store claim adds KOIN points—not cash or partner revenue.
missions.notReady: No new referral has joined today yet.
missions.error: Missions could not be loaded. Please try again.
missions.offersSubtitle: Paid offers, surveys, and playtime missions are not available.
missions.offersSoon: There are no partner missions to complete right now. Missions will appear here when available.
missions.shareError: Could not create your invite link. Please try again.
missions.linkMissing: Sign in again to create your invite link.
missions.partnerBoardSubtitle: Campaign types will appear here after the advertiser feed is connected.
missions.partnerFeedDescription: Provider and campaign verification details are not configured yet. These route previews do not carry rewards.
missions.installDescription: Install an advertiser app, complete its required in-app action, and wait for a verified partner callback.
missions.ptcDescription: Visit a sponsored page and complete its minimum view or reading time. Only partner-verified activity can qualify.
missions.followDescription: Follow a campaign account. Verification must come from an approved partner flow—never share an X password.
missions.surveyDescription: Take a validated survey or try a partner game when a funded campaign is available.
missions.inventoryNotice: No paid partner campaign is claimable until inventory, reward funding, verification, and settlement rules are connected.

wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.empty: Your activity history will appear here.
wallet.cashNote: Shows the recorded IDR ledger balance; it is not an available payout balance. Payouts are inactive, and KOIN has not been converted to OSID or IDR.
wallet.coinNote: This is the current in-app KOIN ledger. KOIN has not been converted into settlement OSID or IDR.
wallet.osidStatus: Not issued in this app yet
wallet.osidNote: The current wallet stores KOIN, IDR, and USD only. No OSID ledger or partner settlement is live.
wallet.error: Wallet data could not be loaded. No zero balance is shown.
wallet.sessionError: Account session not found. Sign in again.

network.title: My network
network.shareNote: Anyone who signs up through this link will be connected as your direct referral.
network.commissionNote: Network commissions are not available. Referral tracking does not currently result in a cash payment.
network.error: Network data could not be loaded. Counts are hidden rather than shown as zero.

withdraw.title: Withdraw funds
withdraw.subtitle: Cash-out is designed around settled partner revenue. Campaign sync, period valuation, and payout requests are not active yet.
withdraw.methods: If payouts are enabled, only channels supported through Midtrans will be shown here.
withdraw.min: Minimum amounts, fees, and estimated processing times will be shown before a request can be submitted.
withdraw.soon: Midtrans payouts cannot be requested until settled funds and reconciliation are ready.
withdraw.coinNote: Existing KOIN does not automatically become an IDR balance. Conversion must follow an approved settlement-pool rule.
withdraw.sourceDescription: Payouts can only use partner funds that have settled into a period pool. Campaign sync and reconciliation are not connected yet.
withdraw.stepRevenueNote: Verified callbacks, received settlement, recorded reversals.
withdraw.stepValueNote: Finance locks eligible OSID and IDR value after reserves.
withdraw.stepReviewNote: Midtrans fees, limits, risk checks, and reconciliation before sending.
withdraw.feeDescription: Per the selected product rule, fee and tax will be shown and deducted from the payout before confirmation. Contract rate and minimum are not set yet.

admin.title: Admin console
admin.subtitle: Account, activity, and platform controls.
admin.denied: This page is restricted to accounts with the admin or owner role.
admin.error: Unable to load the admin overview.
admin.reasonPlaceholder: Describe the signal to review (5–500 characters).
admin.flagNotice: Flags send accounts for human review only; they do not automatically block a member.
admin.featureNote: These switches affect store claims, store upgrades, and daily mission rewards immediately.
admin.featureDailyMissionsDescription: Allow or pause daily check-in and verified referral rewards.
admin.featureStoreClaimsDescription: Allow or pause the internal KOIN-points claim action.
admin.featureStoreUpgradesDescription: Allow or pause store level upgrades.

products.title: A virtual-store tier, not a machine.
products.subtitle: See what a tier is intended to change—and which parts of OSIDAC are actually live.
products.perCampaign: Future eligible, verified partner campaigns only. No campaign is active; this does not affect KOIN.
products.checkoutNote: No purchase, payment, or OSID credit can be made here. Prices and tier effects are a plan, not an offer for sale.
products.settlementNote: If launched, OSID-to-IDR value would vary with verified partner revenue after settlement. No fixed rate, OSID balance, or payout is active today.
products.purchaseStatus: This is a catalog preview, not a working checkout. No payment or order can be made; no tier entitlement, extra mission access, or OSID reward is active.
products.purchaseStatusTitle: No tier package is for sale today
products.tierEffectTitle: What each tier is meant to change
products.tierStoreTitle: Start at a higher virtual-store level
products.tierStoreBody: The live virtual store uses its level to determine the amount of internal KOIN points earned on an eight-hour claim. A tier is planned to set a starting level, but tier purchases are not wired to the store yet.
products.tierOsidBody: The 1.2×–2.0× multiplier is planned for eligible, verified, partner-funded OSID rewards from partner missions after settlement. No partner mission or OSID ledger is live; this does not multiply current KOIN points.
products.tierAccessBody: No additional missions or features unlock with these tiers today. The mission-access matrix and partner inventory have not been approved or connected.
products.currentServiceBody: The current free virtual store supports an in-app KOIN claim every eight hours and level upgrades paid in KOIN. KOIN is non-cash and not withdrawable; the tier cards do not change this live service.
